$comment.why: hark/engine is numeric DSP code (numpy arrays, frame and sample math). Dense arithmetic raises operand counts, live locals and Python body depth without a control-flow problem. Each relaxed metric is set just past the largest value of a function that breached only minor metrics in the T-15 timeline evidence (303 functions). Control flow keeps the defaults: cyclomaticComplexity, essentialComplexity, moduleDesignComplexity, globalDataComplexity and specifiedDataComplexity are not set here.
$comment.scopeDepthRatio: Python counts the function body as depth 1, so a flat 3-line function scores 1.67 against the default 1.3. 110 minor breaches, largest 2.71 on a 7-line function. Real nesting stays judged by scopeDepthWeightedLoc and cyclomaticComplexity.
